boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named academic environments at SUNY Maritime College, selected from current college pages and official facility policies. Confirm access or booking details before relying on a room.

cards.title: Stephen B. Luce Library
cards.subtitle: Fort Schuyler
cards.notes: Start with the library for catalog searching, print and digital collections, research assistance, computers, printing, scanning, and designated quiet space.
cards.short_summary: A campus research base with library services and quiet-study support.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime identifies Luce Library as its academic library; its handbook lists computers, printing, scanning, quiet spaces, research help, and collaborative tech-enhanced spaces.
cards.source_title: Stephen B. Luce Library | SUNY Maritime College
cards.access_notes: Library policies state that its computers are available to SUNY Maritime students, faculty, and staff; check the library site for current hours.

cards.entity_name: Stephen B. Luce Library Study Rooms
cards.title: Luce Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Stephen B. Luce Library, Fort Schuyler
cards.notes: Use a study room for a focused solo or group session; reserve through the circulation desk, phone, or the library’s listed online process.
cards.short_summary: Bookable student-only rooms for focused work.
cards.evidence_claim: Library policy says study rooms are for SUNY Maritime students, are first-come unless reserved, and may be reserved for 30 minutes to three hours per day.
cards.access_notes: Students only. Reservations require confirmation within 24 hours; the reserving student must be present, and food or drink is not permitted.

cards.title: Bay 4 at Luce Library
cards.subtitle: Stephen B. Luce Library, Fort Schuyler
cards.notes: Choose Bay 4 when you need a library area where food and drink are permitted; clean up promptly and reserve it when planning an event.
cards.short_summary: The library’s food-and-drink-permitted bay and reservable event area.
cards.evidence_claim: Library policy permits food and drink in Bay 4 and makes Bay 4 available to faculty, staff, and students for events on a first-come basis with electronic requests.
cards.access_notes: For event use, submit the library’s electronic request. Food and drink are allowed in this bay; bottles with screw-on tops are allowed throughout the library.

cards.entity_name: Stephen B. Luce Library Computer Area
cards.title: Library Computer Area
cards.subtitle: Stephen B. Luce Library, Fort Schuyler
cards.notes: Bring headphones for audio work and save files to your own USB or external drive when using the library’s first-come computer access.
cards.short_summary: A first-come workstation option within the academic library.
cards.evidence_claim: Library policy allows SUNY Maritime students, faculty, and staff to use library computers on a first-come basis and requires headphones for audio.
cards.access_notes: Available to SUNY Maritime students, faculty, and staff on a first-come basis. Users may not change computer settings or install software.

cards.title: Learning Center
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Heritage Hall
cards.notes: Set up a solo block, meet classmates, or work beside a tutor in the Learning Center; consult its posted tutoring schedule before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated Heritage Hall study environment with tutoring nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime says the Learning Center is on Heritage Hall’s third floor and offers students a place to study alone, with classmates, or with tutors.
cards.access_notes: The college directs students to its tutoring schedules from the Learning Center page; availability can vary by schedule.

cards.title: Math Lab
cards.subtitle: Learning Center, Heritage Hall
cards.notes: Use the Learning Center’s linked Math Lab schedule to plan a problem-set session, and verify the listed subject coverage and tutoring availability first.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled math-support setting within the Learning Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The current Learning Center page links to a Spring 2026 Math Lab tutoring schedule and describes the center as a place to study with tutors.
cards.access_notes: Located through the Learning Center on Heritage Hall’s third floor; consult the current Math Lab schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Writing Center
cards.subtitle: SUNY Maritime academic support
cards.notes: Bring a draft, assignment, or reading problem to a Writing Center session; use TracCloud for a group or individual appointment, or check drop-in options.
cards.short_summary: A writing-focused environment for drafting, revision, and reading strategies.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime says Writing Center tutors model reading, writing, and revision techniques; students may drop in or schedule group tutoring and 30- or 50-minute individual appointments.
cards.access_notes: Use TracCloud to schedule individual or group tutoring; the college says its schedule is updated periodically.

cards.title: MAC Smart Classrooms
cards.subtitle: Maritime Academic Center
cards.notes: Use this technology-equipped classroom setting for an arranged class, training, or meeting when a projected display and Smart Board support the work.
cards.short_summary: A 24-person academic room type with presentation technology.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime describes MAC Smart Classrooms as settings for trainings, lectures, and meetings, with a capacity of 24 and a projection screen, Smart Board, desktop, and AV support.
cards.source_title: Conference and Meeting Rentals | SUNY Maritime College
cards.access_notes: This is an arranged-use classroom/meeting setting, not documented as general drop-in study space. Contact the college for scheduling or access.

cards.title: MAC Standard Classrooms
cards.subtitle: Maritime Academic Center
cards.notes: Plan class-related collaboration in a scheduled standard classroom, where the documented LCD display and room capacities suit group review or presentation work.
cards.short_summary: Scheduled MAC classrooms with LCD presentation support.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime states that the Maritime Academic Center has four 24-person, two 48-person, and one 72-person standard classrooms with PC desktop and LCD-screen AV access.
cards.source_title: Conference and Meeting Rentals | SUNY Maritime College
cards.access_notes: This is an arranged-use classroom setting, not documented as general drop-in study space. Contact the college for scheduling or access.

cards.title: Science & Engineering Lecture Hall
cards.subtitle: SUNY Maritime College
cards.notes: Use this large, scheduled academic venue only for a class or authorized session that benefits from its 220-inch projection screen and laptop connectivity.
cards.short_summary: A large academic presentation environment with high-capacity AV.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime lists the Science & Engineering Lecture Hall with a 220-inch projection screen, 4K laser screen, desktop, laptop plug-in capability, microphones, and a capacity of 220.
cards.source_title: Conference and Meeting Rentals | SUNY Maritime College
cards.access_notes: This is an arranged-use lecture venue, not documented as general drop-in study space. Contact the college for scheduling or access.
